meta.description: Gene and region-based rare-variant aggregation - burden/collapsing, SKAT, SKAT-O, ACAT-V/ACAT-O, annotation-weighted STAAR - with regenie (--vc-tests), SAIGE-GENE+, and the SKAT R package. Single-variant tests are powerless at low minor allele count, so rare variants are aggregated across a gene or region under an explicit mask (functional class plus a MAF cutoff). A burden test collapses variants into one score assuming a single effect direction (powerful when true, near-zero power when risk and protective variants cancel); SKAT is a variance-component test robust to mixed directions; SKAT-O blends the two; ACAT/STAAR are dependence-robust and annotation-weighted. The mask is the hypothesis, imbalance needs SPA or Firth, and testing burden is per-gene-per-mask. Use when aggregating rare coding or regulatory variants into gene or region tests, choosing burden vs SKAT vs SKAT-O, or building masks. For single-variant GWAS see association-testing; for mask annotations see variant-calling/variant-annotation.
meta.execution_note: Mode A. WSL agents distro via tar hand-over: plink2 v2.0.0-a.6.9, regenie 4.1.3 and r-saige 1.3.1 (bioconda; tbb<2021 pinned so SAIGE.so loads); Windows R 4.4.3 with SKAT 2.2.5 in the candidate R library. Data SYNTHETIC (data/make_rv_data.py, seed 20260915): 2,000 unrelated samples, 180 cases, covariates age/sex/PC1/PC2, 1,200 common array SNPs on 3 chromosomes, 30 genes with 462 rare variants (LoF/missense/synonymous); planted G01 burden (LoF+missense risk), G11 mixed-direction missense, G21 LoF-only; 27 null genes. STAAR was not run (text only). Inputs executed: 5/5. Layer-1 avg 34.6/40, Layer-2 avg 50.4/60, assertion pass rate 15/20 (75%). Grade note: Production Ready floor not met (assertions): downgraded one tier.

scientific_integrity.detail: No fabricated values; references (Li & Leal 2008, Madsen & Browning 2009, Wu 2011, Lee 2012, Liu 2019, Li 2020, Mbatchou 2021, Zhou 2022) are real with correct DOIs.

methodological_ground.detail: Burden/SKAT/SKAT-O behaviour matched planted truth (G11 burden p=0.054 vs SKAT p=0.0025; G21 LoF-only mask p=3e-14 vs LoF+missense 2.5e-3); calibration on nulls acceptable (regenie lambda 1.04).

code_usability.detail: SKAT, regenie step 2 and SAIGE step 2 ran; the step-1 block, the example script and the bgen form of the SAIGE command fail with explicit errors (P1), not silent wrong results.

functional_suitability.note: Test-selection logic (burden vs SKAT vs SKAT-O, mask as hypothesis, SPA/Firth, per-gene-per-mask burden) is correct, and the SKAT R block ran verbatim. Defects found by running it: the SKILL.md regenie step-1 block has no --bt and stops on a binary trait ("very few unique values"); regenie adds an "all" mask, not the "implicit singleton mask" the version block describes; the SAIGE-GENE+ --annotation_in_groupTest string has its separators reversed (SAIGE: comma separates tests, semicolon joins annotations), so "lof;lof,missense;lof,missense,synonymous" runs lof, missense+lof, missense-only and synonymous-only instead of the three nested masks; the printed step-2 command uses --bgenFile without the --bgenFileIndex/--sampleFile it needs.

reliability.note: Common Errors covers skat-o spelling (confirmed: "unrecognized VC test: 'skat-o'"), missing burden files and Firth/SPA; it misses the step-1 --bt omission and the reversed SAIGE separators.

agent_usability.note: Clear mechanism-first framing; the in-code comment describing SAIGE group syntax contradicts the tool and would mislead an agent.

human_usability.note: Usage-guide prompts map to the decision tree.

maintainability.note: Shipped example reuses one genotype prefix for step 1 and step 2 and fails on a rare-variant-only set; no test data.

agent_specific.note: Precise scope with explicit routing to association-testing, variant-annotation and clinical-databases/variant-prioritization.

inputs.label: SAIGE-GENE+ for an imbalanced trait
inputs.note: The SKILL.md step 2 as printed failed (bgen input requires --bgenFileIndex and --sampleFile). With PLINK input it ran: Cauchy p G21 5.1e-8, G01 7.2e-5, G11 0.019; 1 of 27 null genes <0.05. recommendations.title: SAIGE-GENE+ group syntax is reversed
recommendations.problem: "lof;lof,missense;lof,missense,synonymous" makes SAIGE test lof, missense+lof, missense-only and synonymous-only, not the three nested masks; the comment describing the syntax is backwards.
recommendations.root_cause: Separator semantics not checked against step2_SPAtests.R --help (comma = tests, semicolon = annotations within a test).

recommendations.title: regenie step-1 block omits --bt
recommendations.problem: The SKILL.md step-1 command fails on a binary phenotype ("very few unique values"), while step 2 uses --bt.
recommendations.fix: Add --bt to step 1 whenever step 2 uses --bt, as the shipped example already does.

recommendations.title: Shipped example runs step 1 on the rare-variant genotypes
recommendations.problem: rare_variant_test.sh passes one genotype prefix to both steps; step 1 on a rare-variant set stops with a low-variance SNP error.
recommendations.fix: Take separate array and exome prefixes (or filter step 1 to MAC/MAF-QC'd common variants).

recommendations.title: regenie adds an "all" mask, not a singleton mask
recommendations.problem: The version block says --aaf-bins always adds an implicit singleton mask; regenie 4.1.3 emitted ".all" masks and no singleton mask.
recommendations.fix: Say that an all-variant mask is added and that singleton masks need --singleton-carrier.

recommendations.title: SAIGE step-2 bgen command incomplete
recommendations.problem: --bgenFile is shown without --bgenFileIndex and --sampleFile, which the tool requires.
recommendations.fix: Add both flags, or show the --bedFile/--bimFile/--famFile form.
